hooks.name: Cloud Architect Review on IaC Change
hooks.description: When an infrastructure-as-code file is saved, activate the cloud-architect-reviewer skill to review the change against AWS best practices and the Well-Architected Framework, with cited, active AWS documentation.

action.prompt:
An infrastructure-as-code file was just saved. Activate the `cloud-architect-reviewer` skill (via the skill activation / disclose_context tool) and follow it to review the change.

First confirm the saved file is genuinely infrastructure-as-code or cloud architecture config (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, SAM, Terraform, Serverless Framework, Pulumi, or related deployment/config such as cdk.json, IAM policies, or CI deploy workflows). If it is NOT infrastructure/cloud code, do nothing and stay silent — do not review application logic, UI, or unrelated files.

If it IS infrastructure/cloud code, perform the review exactly as the cloud-architect-reviewer skill instructs: read the changed file and the stack/constructs it depends on, assess against the AWS Well-Architected pillars, keep findings concise and ranked by severity, and cite active, relevant AWS documentation (validated via web search/fetch, never from memory) for every proposal or consideration. Review and advise only — do not modify infrastructure unless the user explicitly asks.
